error-no-database: Please run 'CRD: Examine code relationships' command first to create the database.
ast-enabled-description: Examine relationships of TypeScript/JavaScript files from the syntax tree (tree-sitter) instead of the language server's reference search. Turn off to roll back to the language server; files examined the other way are re-examined.
ast-lsp-verification-description: Ask the language server for the definition of relationships whose confidence is below the threshold, and replace them with the answer.
ast-confidence-threshold-description: Relationships examined from the syntax tree are shown when their confidence is at least this value. Relationships below it are verified with the language server.
